All core features tested and working: auth (register/login), 3-step onboarding, dashboard, marketplace (search/filter/toggle), service detail with Stripe checkout, AI assistant with streaming responses, messages, provider listing creation, navigation (sidebar/FAB/mobile), and responsive design. Backend integration verified 100%.
